# AI Mobile Studio v1.0.0 Release Notes

Welcome to the initial official release of **AI Mobile Studio**!

### Key Capabilities
- **Rootless PRoot Linux Runtime**: Real development environments on your phone with zero root requirements.
- **5 Agent Adapters**: Claude Code, Antigravity CLI, DeepSeek Coder (with reasoning traces), OpenCode Assistant, and Generic Custom CLI.
- **Hardware-Backed Keystore Security**: AES-256 GCM encryption ensures your API keys are never stored in plaintext or logged.
- **11 Project Templates**: React, Next.js, Vite, Node.js, static web, Python 3, Android, C++, PHP, and Generic Linux.
- **Embedded Tools**: Mobile code editor with line numbers, interactive Linux terminal, live WebView preview on localhost ports (3000, 4173, 5173, 8000, 8080), and on-device Android APK builder with Android Package Installer integration.
